title: Life changing
body: I usually never write reviews about any app but for this I have to. It helped me change my life and find better ways to manage my illness and make the most out of it. No more ashamed of my condition, I will make the best use of it. Thankyou so much <3
author: Shrizzya

title: Very cute and comfy
body: Very cute app. Great interface for tracking and viewing stuff.
author: Buzzo1234

title: Absolutely Amazing
body: I have used a lot of health tracking apps, but bearable makes the process incredibly simple and yet detailed. I can look back on how my mood is changing throughout the day or week or month. And it can also help me track down that what exactly might be the activities that are affecting my mood.
author: Arpan Vinayak
